tla_archive.catalog.rule.item_id: Any copy of this item counts. Its name, damage and other data are ignored.
tla_archive.catalog.rule.banner_base_col: Any banner of this base colour counts, with or without patterns.
tla_archive.catalog.rule.potion_effect: A drinkable, splash or lingering potion whose only effect is this one counts, at any strength or duration. Water, awkward and multi-effect potions and tipped arrows don't count.
tla_archive.catalog.rule.enchantment_on_: An enchanted book that stores this enchantment at any level counts. A book with several enchantments counts once for each of them. Enchanted tools and armour don't count.
